Mushrooms:

&#x200B;

I was sitting behind someone who was smoking a joint and the smoke rising from his head triggered something in my brain and all of a sudden everyone's faces starting going red and blistering and burning up. 

Another time (same night), we we're lying on our backs staring up at the stars. It was the British countryside so there was no light pollution. A really beautiful clear sky, with no clouds. The start became pixels (probably a sign I spend too much time on the computer) and started going off like 8-bit fireworks. Ended up watching a giant cosmic game of pong. Really cool.

&#x200B;

Acid:

Was at a festival in the campsite. We got crew camping so there was much more room. There was a bar, hot showers, and good food, so we spent a lot if time in the camp site. Anyway, we woke up, got some food, and promptly dropped a couple tabs of acid. FUCK ME it was one of THE BEST experiences I've had. We we're all wearing beach type stuff. Think shorts and bikinis. The sun was shining gloriously and we just pumped tunes and stumbled over and around each other. I could feel the photons of light hitting my skin. It was almost like there was some electricity flowing between everyone. No proper visuals, but just like an after image or a blur.
